subject: Review your failed test event
preview_text: Check the failure context before replaying the same event.
body:
A failed test event gives you something concrete to inspect before sending it again. Open that event first and review its delivery context, so you can check the failure you are about to replay.

Hookdeck’s Event Gateway provides observability and control over inbound webhook activity, including issue detection and webhook replay. That keeps the review and retry focused on the same event in your test environment.

Once you have checked the context, retry that same test event from Hookdeck. Replaying it lets you run the event again after reviewing the failure, instead of treating the first attempt as a black box.

subject: Check the event, then retry
preview_text: Review its delivery attempts before replaying it from Hookdeck.
body:
Start in Hookdeck’s Events section. Open the failed event in your test environment, then expand it to see the attempts made to deliver it to your webhook endpoint.

Hookdeck is an event gateway for observing inbound webhooks and replaying events. Reviewing the delivery attempts puts the event’s previous activity in view before you send that same event again.

Review the attempts for this failed test event, then retry it from Hookdeck when you are ready. That keeps the review and replay tied to the same test event.
